newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia has FIM 100 mln China GSM expansion.
newsitem.headline: Nokia has FIM 100 mln China GSM expansion.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had signed a major GSM network expansion contract with the Yunnan Post and Telecommunications Administration in China.
The value of the contract was "over 100 million markka," Nokia said.

"Nokia will deliver to Yunnan PTA an expansion of subscriber capacity for digital GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) systems and Short Message Service," it said, adding deliveries would begin at end-February.
"After the expansion, the GSM network will have a capacity of over 200,000 subscribers," Nokia said.
The initial GSM network delivered by Nokia to Yunnan came on stream in May 1996 and Nokia supplied a first expansion of the network in the second half of last year.
The new expansion would bring "increased capacity, enhanced coverage as well as leading edge technology," Nokia said.
